shortDescription: Consul ACL policy management for v1.5.0

options.name: address
options.description: The url to connect to consul. Using '<schema>//<domain>:<port>'. For a unix domain socket, give 'unix:' with literal location. Example: 'unix:///var/run/consul/http.sock'.

options.name: datacenters
options.description: Limits what datacenters the policy can be used towards.

options.name: description
options.description: A readable short description of the policy.

options.name: management_token
options.description: A token with permissions to create or modify the policy.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique name of the policy you wish to create or modify. Required when C(state=present)

options.name: policy_id
options.description: A UUID of an already existing policy. You must define when modifying an existing policy.

options.name: rules
options.description: A json string with ACL rules as defined in consul's guide here https://www.consul.io/docs/acl/acl-rules.html Required when C(state=present)

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the policy should be present or absent from consul
